items.t: SLB Expands Norway Footprint With Var Energi Offshore Drilling Deal
items.sum: SLB secures a long-term offshore drilling services contract with Var Energi in Norway, boosting revenue visibility and growth opportunities through 2034.
SLB has outperformed the broader market, supported by strong analyst optimism, despite declining earnings estimates and expectations of future growth.

items.t: SLB LTD (NYSE:SLB): A Quality Investing Candidate With Strong Free Cash Flow
items.sum: SLB passes most Caviar Cruise quality filters with strong ROIC and cash flow, though weak revenue growth remains a key concern for investors.

items.t: Chevron to begin offshore oil and gas exploration in Greece
items.sum: Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY are set to begin seismic surveys for oil and gas in Greece’s southern Ionian Sea. The results could help determine whether to drill in a country that relies on imported gas.View on euronews
